title: Synthesized eval adapters and dataset fingerprint integrator for stable profile generation
creator: Priya Menon
description:
Problem: onboarding new open-model variants is noisy—different dataset sampling, prompt variant assignment, and runner bindings produce non-reproducible performance profiles. This makes version pinning brittle and causes spurious regressions during rollouts.

Goal: extend the benchmark harness with two orthogonal capabilities: (1) a lightweight eval-adapter interface that standardizes how eval runners bind to model leases, sampling constraints, and output normalization; and (2) a dataset fingerprint integrator that computes deterministic selectors and stable context windows across dataset shuffles and ingestion pipelines. The outcome should be reliable, comparable profile artifacts that can be published to the catalog and used for automated regression checks and protected rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: 1) New eval-adapter API implemented with backward-compatible shims so existing runners still work. 2) Dataset fingerprint produced for every dataset version; fingerprint used by sampler to deterministically pick seeds for a profile run. 3) Profile artifacts include adapter metadata, dataset_fingerprint, model_version_pin, and rollout_compatibility hints. 4) End-to-end run (small seed job) produces identical token-level metrics across two repeated runs on the same commit. 5) Documentation and a how-to for model onboards added to Confluence. 6) Integration tests added to CI verifying fingerprint stability across common ingestion transformations.
technical_notes:
- Eval-adapter is intentionally minimal: lifecycle hooks (prepare_lease, bind_runner, normalize_output, teardown). Avoid over-generalizing; complex orchestration stays in harness controller.
- Fingerprint approach: compute a compact digest over (dataset_schema, canonicalized-sample-hashes, tokenizer_version, canonical-seed-map). Use SHA256 and truncate to 16 bytes for artifact IDs.
- Sampler changes: map fingerprint -> deterministic RNG seeds -> sampled-index-list. Allow opt-in stochastic perturbation for stress tests.
- Profile artifact schema additions: dataset_fingerprint, adapter_version, runner_commit, sample_seed_map, input_token_stats. Keep artifacts small (gzip JSONL) and store to s3://redwood-profiles/ with immutability tags.
- Rollout hint: add top-3 comparable-models field populated by model-onboarding service to support fallback selection when serving variants are absent.
design_decisions_and_tradeoffs:
- Chose fingerprinting over full dataset snapshot to limit storage. Tradeoff: small chance of collision vs. huge cost of snapshotting. Mitigation: include canonicalized sample hashes plus tokenizer id.
- Eval-adapter vs. full runner refactor: adapters allow incremental migration of older runners without rewriting them. Slight overhead from the shim but faster delivery.
- Deterministic seeding is chosen as primary mode; we will retain a randomized mode for later synthetic stress tests.
- Publishing artifact immutability requires S3 lifecycle rules; ops must confirm retention policy before GA.
implementation_plan: 1) RFC and API proto sketch (this ticket). 2) Implement eval-adapter interface + two example adapters (hf-transformer-runner, text-only-microbench). 3) Implement dataset fingerprint generator as a library callable from ingestion and harness. 4) Wire sampler to consume fingerprint -> seed map. 5) Update profile publisher to add new metadata keys and upload to canonical bucket. 6) Add CI checks and small-scale E2E run. 7) Docs and handoff to onboarding team.
timeline: Week 1: API proto + RFC review; Week 2: adapter shim + dataset fingerprint lib; Week 3: sampler integration + profile publisher updates; Week 4: CI tests, docs, and early run. Contingency +2 weeks for ops S3 retention alignment.
blockers:
- Need final signoff from Storage/Ops on immutable bucket policy.
- Decision from Security on whether fingerprint content must be redacted for datasets containing PII before publishing.
- Small API change needed from model-onboarding service to attach 'compatible_rollouts' list (ENG action item open).
